divergences.summary: Notification services are explicitly composed in AuthenticatedWindow and CandidateWindow. Launch remains a minimal task surface and does not import the notification subsystem.

Linked content is text unless a composition supplies an authorized effect. Copy/open capability interfaces remain available and tested; current production windows intentionally supply neither generic opener nor clipboard access. Action errors use a localized bounded message; raw errors are not logged.

Complete base list/scrollbar and progress-bar mechanics are retained. Row details/main/progress hierarchy and action-bar hierarchy match upstream; notification, action, button and Modern UI CSS is transferred with owner/token mapping. Authorized native toolbar buttons replace anchor button leaves without changing geometry. Measured rows fit the actual host width; managed CSSStyleSheets preserve per-list focus styling under CSP.

Non-sensitive preferences use versioned bound Proctor scopes; notification messages and actions are window-session only. Invalid preferences fall back safely; writes remain effective in the current window when persistence fails. No server-authoritative user setting is shadowed.

Active progress cannot be ordinarily cleared from rows, keyboard, Clear All or Accessible View. This closes the upstream accessible-view dismissal bypass. Cancellation and producer handle close remain explicit operation-owner actions. Delayed progress accumulates reports made before display and disposes every timer on window teardown.

Toasts/center retain the three upstream placements using reserved window geometry; the bell stays in the workbench status area and Launch mounts no notifications. The center retains separate mute and position dropdowns. Accessible reading uses a native read-only text area, and sound-engine registration is excluded while textual feedback remains available.

LaunchWindow reuses the complete admitted DomScrollableElement with automatic vertical overlay visibility, a hidden horizontal axis, and no inset shadow on its continuous canvas. Viewport/content resize observations and DOM scroll synchronization preserve layout and focus reveal; owner keyboard handling provides page and arrow scrolling. Shared track stays transparent, interaction colors use dedicated Proctor tokens, and the Modern UI thumb rounding is always enabled. Launch still mounts no notification UI.
The retained source-derived notification renderer exposes default/compact row metrics. Lists subscribe to the density event and remeasure existing rows; listener lifetime belongs to the list.
